Paired with [[Scimitar of the Seven|Scimitars of the Seven]], they make the [[Champion's Arms]]. They were designed to be both lightweight and durable, and the gold used to make them is handpicked to ensure this. They belong to the [[Gerudo Gear]] equipment archetype. {{Frameless|[[File:BotW Urbosa Artwork.png|thumb|left|200px|alt= Artwork of Urbosa carrying her Daybreaker.|Urbosa with a Daybreaker]]}} Before the [[Great Calamity]], a Daybreaker was beloved by the [[Gerudo]] [[Champion]] [[Urbosa]]. Both it and her Scimiat of the Seven were made by a Gerudo jeweler. During the [[EX Recovered Memory]] "[[Champion Urbosa's Song (Memory)|Champion Urbosa's Song]]", Urbosa can be seen performing a [[Parry]] with her Daybreaker. After Urbosa's death, her Daybreaker and Scimitar became treasures of the Gerudo. After defeating [[Thunderblight Ganon]] and calming [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]], [[Riju]] will offer [[Link]] both pieces. She believes it is right he should have them, as he was friends with Urbosa. Both Items can be found in [[Stone Chest]]s behind [[Riju's Throne]] in the [[Royal Palace]] of [[Gerudo Town]]. If either Item breaks, [[Buliara]] will offer to remake them for Link. To create a Daybreaker, she needs one [[Diamond]], five pieces of [[Flint]], and a [[Gerudo Shield]]. [[Selmie]] will take note of a Daybreaker if Link has one equipped when he speaks to her. She will ask if she is dreaming, explaining that she has wanted a Daybreaker so badly that she has seen it in her dreams. Being made of metal, Daybreakers will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can still be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] if it happens. In addition, they will not burn like wooden Shields when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_037" |Life = 60 |GuardPower = 48 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 12 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 13 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 30 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 16 |RideBreakRatio = 0.5 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Daybreaker}} Daybreakers reappear in {{TotK}}. They are part of the [[Arms of the Seven]] alongside [[Scimitar of the Seven|Scimitars of the Seven]], which can only be created by select individuals. These [[Weapon]]s form a bond with their owners, which is only broken when they are permanently lost. According to [[Isha]], an ancestor of hers was responsible for making [[Urbosa]]'s Daybreaker and Scimitar of the Seven. Additionally, the [[Sage of Lightning]] [[Ardi]] can be seen wielding her own Daybreaker and Scimitar in flashbacks to the [[Era of Foundation]]'s [[Imprisoning War]]. During the [[Side Quest]] "[[Pride of the Gerudo]]", Isha chooses to make a Daybreaker and Scimitar of the Seven for [[Link]]. She tasks Link with gathering the supplies she needs to make them, which is his responsibility as the person who will wield the Arms of the Seven. To make a Daybreaker, Isha needs one [[Diamond]], five pieces of [[Flint]], and a [[Gerudo Shield]]. Once Link has brought her all of the [[Material]]s, Isha proceeds to make the Daybreaker and Scimitar for him. When she is done, she gives them to him, saying they are a representation of the gratitude the Gerudo feel for him. She also offers to make a new Daybreaker for Link if his ever breaks. However, she will refuse to do so if his Daybreaker can still be recovered, as his bond with it has not been broken. Whenever Isha makes a Daybreaker for Link, she comments on its vibrant colors and her pride in her own work. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Daybreakers are wielded by Urbosa in conjunction with [[Scimitar of the Seven|Scimitars of the Seven]], which she uses to defend herself against frontal attacks. During several [[Narration]]s and [[Movie]]s, a Daybreaker is featured as Urbosa's default [[Shield]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} [[Ardi]] uses a Daybreaker alongside the [[Scimitar of the Seven]] in battle. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Daybreaker Concept Art.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of a Daybreaker File:TLoZ Urbosa amiibo.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}{{BotW|-}} series Urbosa amiibo with her Daybreaker File:AoC Urbosa Artwork 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Urbosa with her Daybreaker File:AoC Urbosa Tapestry Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of Urbosa with her Daybreaker File:AoI Ardi Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoI|-}}}}Artwork of Ardi with her Daybreaker ==See Also== {{See Also| * Arms of the Seven * Gerudo Gear * Gerudo Shield * Radiant Shield * Scimitar of the Seven * Shield }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Daybreaker}}
